# @canopy/studio

Canopy Studio as static assets, with a fetch style handler that serves them at /studio under a strict Content Security Policy.

`@canopy/server` serves it at `/studio`; use the handler directly only to host Studio somewhere else.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/studio
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { createServer } from "node:http"
import { createStudioHandler, toNodeListener } from "@canopy/studio"

createServer(toNodeListener(createStudioHandler())).listen(3001)
```
